blocks.label: QT GUI Graphic Overlay Sample Source
RFNoC Keep One in N Block

catalog_hash_rule: sha256 over sorted *.block.yml of: file name + NUL + sha256 hex + LF

eligibility.hardware-or-network-module: audio, iio, network, soapy, uhd, zeromq
eligibility.non-block: ids _dummy, epy_block, epy_module, import, note, options, pad_sink, pad_source, parameter, snippet, virtual_sink, virtual_source; ids starting with 'variable'; not_dsp flag; a value expression and no ports

rules.family: key = lower-case name minus one trailing type-signature word of letters bcfisvx, minus a trailing _hier, minus one trailing version digit; blocks share a family when ids or YAML file stems share a key
rules.module: tree file <module>.tree.yml listing the id; else first word of the YAML file name; else 'grc' (built-ins without YAML)
